tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

dsh-experimental-translator.provider.description: Provider selected when a consumer omits it.

dsh-experimental-translator.timeoutMs.description: Deadline covering the request and complete response body, in milliseconds.

dsh-experimental-worktree.description: Worktree location, generated names, executables, and subprocess resource limits.

dsh-experimental-worktree.directory.description: Relative checkout pool inside the source repository.

dsh-experimental-worktree.gitCommand.description: Executable name or absolute execution-world path of a Git release that honors `GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH`.

dsh-experimental-worktree.maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum captured bytes per subprocess output stream.

dsh-experimental-worktree.namePrefix.description: Prefix for automatically generated branch and checkout names.

dsh-experimental-worktree.nodeCommand.description: Node executable used for sandboxed directory allocation.

dsh-experimental-worktree.timeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds for one command.

dsh-file-reference-local.excludedDirecto.description: Directory basenames never traversed or offered.

dsh-file-reference-local.maxEntries.description: Maximum indexed files and directories per agent workspace.

dsh-file-reference-local.maxResults.description: Maximum ranked candidates returned for one query.

dsh-fs-local.description: Configuration for the local filesystem backend.

dsh-fs-local.cwd.description: Base directory for relative paths. Defaults to `process.cwd()`.

dsh-fs-local.diffBasisMaxBytes.description: Exclusive UTF-8 byte limit on each overwrite-diff side, capped by the runtime's safe allocation/decode maximum. Defaults to 10 MiB.

dsh-goal.defaultMaxGoalRounds.description: Total rounds used when a create request omits its own cap.

dsh-headless.description: Plugin config: the task and run options resolved from this app's injected provider service.

dsh-headless.approvalPolicy.description: Approval behavior applied after preset selection; an explicit CLI flag takes precedence. Omission keeps current policy.

dsh-headless.json.description: Whether stdout carries the machine-readable event stream instead of final text.

dsh-headless.permissionMode.description: Permission preset applied before the task; an explicit CLI flag takes precedence. Omission keeps current policy.

dsh-headless.sessionId.description: Exact Session identity to adopt; absent for a fresh random identity. An id with no stored Session fails.

dsh-headless.task.description: The prompt text for the single run; absent when the task arrives on stdin.

dsh-hmr.description: Module roots and watcher timing, with Chokidar deployment options.

dsh-hmr.base.description: Directory resolved against the owning context's base URL.

dsh-hmr.ignored.description: Glob patterns excluded from module watching.

dsh-hmr.root.description: Module watch roots; an empty list leaves only explicit configuration watches.

dsh-hooks-claude-code.description: Plugin config: where the CC hook config lives + substitution roots.

dsh-hooks-claude-code.configPath.description: Path to a `hooks.json` or a settings file whose `hooks` key holds the config. Process-level: read once at load, a relative path resolves against the process launch cwd, so one config applies to the whole process. TODO(per-session-hook-config): per-session discovery of a project-local `hooks.json` from each `session/new.cwd`.

dsh-hooks-claude-code.defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default per-hook timeout in ms when a hook sets none (CC default: 600000).

dsh-hooks-claude-code.pluginRoot.description: Replaces `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` in command strings (the plugin's root dir).

dsh-hooks-claude-code.projectDir.description: Replaces `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}` in command strings AND is exported as the `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` env var for hook processes. When omitted, the env var defaults per-run to the agent's current directory (the same dir the hook runs in) — Claude Code always exports this var, and common unmodified hooks reference `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` for project-relative paths.

dsh-hooks-claude-code.stderrSummaryMaxCh.description: Character cap for the `hook/result` event's persisted stderr summary.

dsh-hooks-codex.description: Plugin config: where the Codex hooks.json lives + the model name for payloads.

dsh-hooks-codex.configPath.description: Path to a Codex `hooks.json`. Process-level: read once at load, a relative path resolves against the process launch cwd. TODO(per-session-hook-config): per-session project-local discovery from each `session/new.cwd`.

dsh-hooks-codex.defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default per-hook timeout in ms when a hook sets none (Codex default: 600000).

dsh-hooks-codex.model.description: The model name stamped on every payload (Codex includes `model` on each event).

dsh-hooks-codex.stderrSummaryMaxChars.description: Character cap for the `hook/result` event's persisted stderr summary.

dsh-host-directory-picker-browse.maxEntr.description: Complete-result bound of one listing level; see {@link BrowseDirectoryPicker.Config}.

dsh-host-frontend-static.distIndex.description: Absolute path of index.html inside the dist root.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.description: Collector routing, application identity, and bounded in-memory batch settings.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.exportTi.description: Processor deadline for one batch export.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.maxExpor.description: Maximum records per export; must not exceed maxQueueSize.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.maxQueue.description: Maximum queued records; the SDK drops new records when full.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.schedule.description: Delay before exporting a partial batch.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.serviceN.description: Resource service.name supplied by the application composition.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.serviceV.description: Resource service.version supplied by the application composition.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.shutdown.description: Drain deadline; expiry cancels pending exports before disposal completes.

dsh-host-product-telemetry-otel.timeoutM.description: Exporter HTTP deadline, including SDK transient-error retries.

dsh-host-webserver.description: Web server listen, TLS, and response-compression config.

dsh-host-webserver.compression.description: Response compression for socket-backed HTTP requests. @default 'none'

dsh-host-webserver.compressionThresholdB.description: Minimum known response length eligible for gzip; unknown-length streams are eligible. @default 1024

dsh-host-webserver.host.description: Listen address: a concrete IPv4 or IPv6 literal of one local interface, for example the container's own Pod address from `hostname -i`. A loopback literal (any address in 127/8, `::1`, or a mapped form of either) keeps the server on this machine; any other literal serves the network that address belongs to, over plain HTTP unless `tls` is set. The unspecified address — IPv4 any, IPv6 any, and the IPv4-mapped forms of IPv4 any — is rejected at load: it would expose the port on every interface at once.

dsh-host-webserver.port.description: Listen port; zero requests an OS-assigned port.

dsh-host-webserver.tls.description: Serve HTTPS with this certificate and key instead of plain HTTP. Both files are read once, before the listener binds: an unreadable or empty file, invalid PEM, or a key that does not match the certificate rejects initialization rather than falling back to HTTP. The material is never re-read, so replacing a certificate takes a reload. Omitted or null listens over plain HTTP.

dsh-jobs-local.description: Configuration for the process-local job registry.

dsh-jobs-local.maxConcurrentJobsPerOwner.description: Maximum `running` plus `stopping` jobs per exact owner or in the shared unowned bucket; omission defaults to 10.

dsh-jobs-local.pumpPollMs.description: Poll interval for a job's pull sources, in milliseconds; omission defaults to 150.

dsh-jobs-local.retainBytes.description: Live ring retention per job in UTF-8 bytes; omission defaults to 262144.

dsh-jobs-local.settledRetainBytes.description: Ring retention kept after a job settles, in UTF-8 bytes; omission defaults to 16384. Settlement keeps every byte the model cursor has not consumed on top of this cap; the first terminal model read then trims to it.

dsh-llm-deepseek-account.description: Account route configuration; authentication comes exclusively from the account service.

dsh-llm-deepseek-account.modelOverrides.description: Field overrides by model id, layered over the account listing and the built-in catalog.

dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key.description: Messages configuration with a per-request API-key reference.

dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key.apiKeyEnv.description: Credential reference resolved per request; defaults to DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

dsh-llm-pi-ai.description: Plugin configuration: the provider routes this instance owns.

dsh-llm-pi-ai.providers.description: pi-ai provider routes, keyed by provider. An empty (or omitted) dict is the dormant settings-driven posture: the adapter mounts with no routes and registers them the moment a settings section supplies profiles.

dsh-llm-replay.description: Plugin config: the {@link ReplayConfig} inputs, each defaulting to its `DSH_SNAPSHOT_*` env var in `apply`.

dsh-llm-replay.childFiles.description: Override the child-log paths; defaults to `$DSH_SNAPSHOT_CHILD_FILES` (a path-separator-delimited list). Each is a recorded subagent session log for a nested-agent scenario; absent/empty for a single-session scenario.

dsh-llm-replay.file.description: Override the fixture path; defaults to `$DSH_SNAPSHOT_FILE`.

dsh-llm-replay.overrideFile.description: Override the sidecar path; defaults to `$DSH_SNAPSHOT_OVERRIDE`.

dsh-llm-replay.paceMs.description: Optional per-chunk pacing delay in ms (see {@link ReplayConfig.paceMs}); absent keeps burst yield.

dsh-llm-replay.providers.description: Optional replay-only provider catalog; absent or empty selects catch-all waterfall replay.

dsh-lsp-stdio.description: Plugin configuration: provider id → local language-server configuration.

dsh-lsp-stdio.servers.description: Non-empty table of stable provider ids to independent local server configurations.

dsh-mcp-client.description: Config for connecting to an MCP server via a spawned child process over stdio.

dsh-mcp-client.args.description: Arguments passed directly, without shell interpolation.

dsh-mcp-client.command.description: Executable used to start the server.

dsh-mcp-client.cwd.description: Working directory for the child process.

dsh-mcp-client.env.description: Extra env vars merged on top of scrubbed ambient env.

dsh-mcp-client.failOnStartupError.description: Fail plugin activation when the initial connection or tool synchronization fails.

dsh-mcp-client.maxInstructionBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes of attributed server instructions (default 32768).

dsh-mcp-client.reconnect.description: Automatic reconnect policy after a lost connection; omission uses the defaults.

dsh-mcp-client.serverName.description: Stable local namespace for this server's model-facing tool names (`mcp__<serverName>__<rawName>`). Must match `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}` and be unique across live mcp-client instances.

dsh-mcp-client.toolCallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout per tool call or resource request in milliseconds.

dsh-message-feedback.description: Required deployment policy for optional notes.

dsh-office-to-pdf.description: Provider concurrency and kit rendering/font configuration.

dsh-office-to-pdf.fontDirectories.description: Absolute font roots; omission uses the kit's platform defaults.

dsh-office-to-pdf.fontFallbacks.description: Ordered font-family preference groups; omission retains the kit defaults.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxBackgroundConversio.description: Maximum concurrent background jobs; zero refuses speculative work.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxConcurrentConversio.description: Maximum simultaneous conversions; queued callers remain cancellable.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxFontFiles.description: Maximum physical font files indexed by each converter.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxLoadedFontBytes.description: Maximum original font bytes loaded for a conversion.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxQueuedJobs.description: Maximum metadata-only jobs awaiting source admission.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxSourceBytes.description: Maximum reserved bytes across admitted source reads and conversions.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxSourceEntries.description: Maximum retained source-version aliases to cached content.

dsh-office-to-pdf.maxUncompressedBytes.description: Maximum total declared uncompressed OOXML bytes.

dsh-office-to-pdf.timeoutMs.description: Conversion deadline in milliseconds; excludes the DSH queue.

dsh-permission-presets.description: The {@link PermissionPresetService} config: preset table and composition default.

dsh-permission-presets.defaultPreset.description: Default for new sessions. When omitted, the preset matching the composed sandbox and approval defaults is used.

dsh-permission-presets.presets.description: The preset table: name → knob bundle. Defaults to `workspace-write` (workspace-write + ask) and `danger-full-access` (danger-full-access + never). The names `custom` and `auto` are reserved for derived state and the Auto review integration respectively.

dsh-persona.description: Plugin config: the persona text this composition contributes.

dsh-persona.complete.description: Make the prefix the complete system prompt, suppressing the suffix and every other section.

dsh-persona.includeRuntimeContext.description: Suppress dynamic runtime-context snapshots for this persona's agent scope.

dsh-persona.prefix.description: Persona prose rendered as the `deployment:persona-prefix` section. A template: complete `{{…}}` groups interpolate strictly against registered prompt variables. Empty text drops the section at render, matching the registry.

dsh-persona.suffix.description: Persona suffix template rendered after first-party guidance. Omitted or empty text shadows the deployment suffix away; interpolation is strict.

dsh-plan-mode.section.description: Guidance rendered as the `plan:policy` prompt section while plan mode is active.

dsh-plugin-manager.description: The pnpm executable, registries, and limits for diagnostics, lookups and connection checks.

dsh-plugin-manager.detailFetchTimeoutMs.description: Deadline of one npm file CDN request for an offered bundle's detail document.

dsh-plugin-manager.detailImageMaxBytes.description: Largest image served beside a bundle detail document, in bytes.

dsh-plugin-manager.detailMaxBytes.description: Largest bundle detail document, and largest locale file read for one, in bytes.

dsh-plugin-manager.detailNpmFileSources.description: npm file CDNs that offered bundles are read from, in order; a read's `npmFileSources` moves the CDNs it names first.

dsh-plugin-manager.fallbackRegistries.description: Registries asked in turn, as http(s) URLs, while the one before is unreachable or holds no copy of the package. A registry outside this set and `registry` is asked alone, and so is the one pnpm's own configuration names unless that is npm's own registry or one of these.

dsh-plugin-manager.gitTransportTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of each HTTP(S) and SSH access probe of a self-hosted Git repository before installation, in milliseconds.

dsh-plugin-manager.githubConnectionTimeo.description: Maximum duration of the GitHub repository connection check before installation, in milliseconds.

dsh-plugin-manager.idleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time one captured package run may print nothing before the manager terminates it, in milliseconds.

dsh-plugin-manager.inspectTimeoutMs.description: Bound on one registry lookup an inspection runs, in milliseconds.

dsh-plugin-manager.lockWaitMs.description: Maximum time to wait for another process's profile package operation.

dsh-plugin-manager.pnpmCommand.description: The pnpm executable name or path; resolved through `PATH` like the `dsh plugin` command.

dsh-plugin-manager.registry.description: The registry lookups and installations ask first, as an http(s) URL; absent, the one pnpm's own configuration names.

dsh-plugin-manager.versionListLimit.description: How many of the newest versions above the installed one a version listing reads and returns.

dsh-plugin-manager.versionLookupConcurre.description: How many single-version registry lookups a version listing runs at once.

dsh-plugin-market.cacheTtlMs.description: Lifetime of a successfully read index document, a detail read result, and a repository's default-branch commit.

dsh-plugin-market.detailCacheDir.description: Directory of the partial clones, relative to the profile directory; absent means `.plugin-market/repositories`.

dsh-plugin-market.detailCacheMaxBytes.description: Largest total size of the partial clones; least recently used ones are deleted beyond it.

dsh-plugin-market.detailGitTimeoutMs.description: Deadline of one Git command of the clone fallback.

dsh-plugin-market.detailGitlabHosts.description: Hosts serving the GitLab repository files API.

dsh-plugin-market.detailImageMaxBytes.description: Largest image beside a detail document in bytes.

dsh-plugin-market.detailNpmFileSources.description: npm file CDNs read in order; a read's `npmFileSources` moves the CDNs it names first.

dsh-plugin-market.detailRepositoryMaxByt.description: Largest amount in bytes one Git command adds to a partial clone; a repository whose fetch adds more is not read.

dsh-plugin-market.fetchTimeoutMs.description: Deadline for one index fetch, including the body.

dsh-plugin-market.indexes.description: Index URLs in display order; Settings and `setIndexes` write this field without remounting the service.

dsh-plugin-market.maxBytes.description: Largest accepted index body in bytes.

dsh-plugin-package-inventory-deepseek.en.description: Contribute `dsh_plugin_packages` to official DeepSeek requests. Defaults to `true`.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.description: Deployment-varying runtime bounds and launch choices.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.executionMode.description: per-call uses fresh async function bodies; vm-script uses VM contexts; persistent-in-memory retains a REPL per owner.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.graceMs.description: Managed process termination and output-drain grace in milliseconds.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.launch.description: Worker invocation in the subprocess world; omitted selects the local carrier.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.maxMessageBytes.description: Maximum control message, outstanding binding-argument and queued control-output bytes.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.maxOldGenerationSiz.description: V8 old-generation heap limit in MiB; native allocations are excluded.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.maxOutputBytes.description: Combined serialized logs, completion and diagnostic byte cap.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.maxPendingCalls.description: Maximum simultaneous host binding calls accepted from a program.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.maxTimeoutMs.description: Maximum numeric elapsed budget accepted by resolve.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.scriptPersistence.description: Retain a Script process and context per stateOwner; only supported with executionMode: vm-script.

dsh-ptc-runtime-node.timeoutMs.description: Default elapsed deadline, including nested tool and approval waits.

dsh-pwsh-local.description: Validated plugin configuration with live command budgets.

dsh-pwsh-local.cwd.description: Default working directory for commands (default: process.cwd()).

dsh-pwsh-local.graceMs.description: Grace period for kill escalation and inherited pipes; at most `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.

dsh-pwsh-local.maxOutputBytes.description: Per-stream in-memory output cap; overflow spills to a temp file.

dsh-pwsh-local.maxSpillBytes.description: Per-stream spill-file cap; larger streams retain only their in-memory tail.

dsh-pwsh-local.maxTimeoutMs.description: Upper bound for per-call timeout overrides.

dsh-pwsh-local.pwshPath.description: Explicit pwsh executable. When omitted, well-known Windows install locations and PATH entries are probed in order (PowerShell 7 install, PATH entries such as the Microsoft Store install, then Windows PowerShell 5.1), falling back to a bare `pwsh` resolved through PATH.

dsh-repeat-tool-reminder.description: Plugin config, validated by the same-named schemastery schema plus the load-time checks in `apply` (misconfiguration fails loud: an empty `thresholds` list, a non-integer, a value below 2, or a duplicate throws at plugin load, never a silent fall-back). `include`/`exclude` entries are `*`-wildcard predicates over tool names at call time, not references to registry entries — a pattern matching no currently registered tool is valid (`exclude: [mcp_*]` must stay legal in a deployment that loads no MCP tools).

dsh-repeat-tool-reminder.argumentsPrevie.description: Maximum characters of canonical arguments quoted in the DETAILED reminder (default 500). Large payloads (a `write` body, a long command) would otherwise ride into the next request unbounded — precisely in a loop scenario; the cap bounds the reminder, never the detection (the chain key always compares the FULL canonical string).

dsh-repeat-tool-reminder.exclude.description: Tool-name patterns transparent to the chain (neither count nor reset).

dsh-repeat-tool-reminder.include.description: Tool-name patterns to track; empty means every tool is tracked.

dsh-repeat-tool-reminder.thresholds.description: Consecutive-repeat counts that trigger a reminder (default `[3, 5, 8]`).

dsh-sandbox-local.description: Plugin config. All optional — `static Config` supplies the defaults.

dsh-sandbox-local.probeTimeoutMs.description: Positive timeout for each functional probe; zero would mean unbounded to Node.

dsh-sandbox-local.runnerCommand.description: Override the runner argv; bwrap-compatible profile arguments are appended. A non-empty override asserts full enforcement and skips built-in selection and probing. A runner that starts but refuses its profile must be identifiable by {@link runnerFailureSignatures}. Consumers classify a spawn rejection only after confirming the workdir is usable. `ENOENT` or `EACCES` identifies the runner when `error.path` equals argv[0] and `error.syscall` is `spawn` or `spawn <runner>`, or when `error.path` is absent and `error.syscall` is exactly `spawn <runner>`.

dsh-sandbox-local.runnerFailureSignature.description: Case-insensitive stderr substrings emitted when a configured {@link runnerCommand} refuses its profile before executing the wrapped command. Required and non-empty with `runnerCommand`; rejected without it. Each entry is a non-empty, single-line, case-insensitive substring covering the executable runner's own failure dialect.

dsh-sandbox-policy.description: Plugin config: the deployment's sandbox default. All optional — `Config` supplies the defaults (`mode: 'read-only'` is the fail-safe default; a deployment that wants a workspace-writable agent opts in explicitly). The runner choice is NOT here (it is the `ctx.sandbox` provider's config), nor is any per-family knob: this is the one shared policy home.

dsh-sandbox-policy.additionalWritableRoo.description: Extra physical absolute directories that `workspace-write` may also write under (default: none). The supervisor names them explicitly; there is no automatic repository or gitfile discovery. Entries are execution-world paths: this service validates absoluteness and detaches the list, while the enforcing host rejects missing, non-directory, or symlinked paths. They grant nothing under `read-only`.

dsh-sandbox-policy.mode.description: File-sandbox mode a session starts from (default: `read-only`).

dsh-sandbox-policy.workspaceRoot.description: Absolute fallback root for agentless calls and sessions without a cwd (default: `process.cwd()`). Normal agent calls use their session cwd instead.

dsh-schedule.description: Configuration for the Host Schedule domain.

dsh-schedule.deliveryHistoryDays.description: Delivery-history window retained per task, in days; omission defaults to 30. Pruning happens when an acknowledgment is appended, and `lastDelivery` is always retained.

dsh-schedule.deliveryHistoryRecords.description: Retained delivery records per task; omission defaults to 200. The older of this cap and the window wins, and the newest records survive.

dsh-schedule.newSessionIntervalSeconds.description: Shortest spacing, in seconds, from the occurrence of one delivery to the next delivery of one task whose target creates a Session at every delivery; omission defaults to 60. Timed and manual deliveries both wait for it.

dsh-sdk-app.profile.description: Profile name rendered in help and diagnostics (default `sdk`).

dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-server.description: JSON-RPC deployment config plus runtime-only test hooks.

dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-server.maxTokensAsSucces.description: Report max-token turn/subagent termination as a successful SDK result.

dsh-session-log-deepseek.enabled.description: Contribute `dsh_session_log` to official DeepSeek requests. Defaults to `true`.

dsh-session-log-deepseek.maxBytes.description: Largest serialized `dsh_session_log` field, in UTF-8 bytes, that one request carries. A request uploads the longest pending event prefix that fits; later requests continue after its acceptance. Defaults to 8 MiB.

dsh-session-persistence-jsonl.description: Plugin config for the JSONL backend's root, physical encoding, and listing concurrency.

dsh-session-persistence-jsonl.compressio.description: Physical encoding; defaults to checksummed Zstandard frames.

dsh-session-persistence-jsonl.listConcur.description: Maximum directory, header, and stat reads in flight across all concurrent listings of this backend (`list()`, the root encoding check, and historical fingerprints). Defaults to 3.

dsh-session-persistence-jsonl.root.description: Root directory for all session files. Required (no default): a default of `process.cwd()` would scatter session files as the process's cwd changes (bash calls, subprocesses). Sessions group under human-readable project directories, then per-session directories. An existing root must be a readable directory; an absent root is created on first materialization.

dsh-session-projection-cache.description: Plugin config. Both throttle triggers are deployment choices with no universally correct value, so the composition states them explicitly (cordis.yml); the three mandatory write points (session creation, `turn/end`, and session disposal) are policy, not tunables, and always fire.

dsh-session-projection-cache.writeEveryE.description: Committed events per session that force a durable checkpoint write between mandatory points.

dsh-session-projection-cache.writeInterv.description: Longest time (milliseconds) a dirty checkpoint may stay unwritten between mandatory points.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.description: Combined session-query configuration backed by SQLite full-text search.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.defaultLimit.description: Page size when a request omits `limit`. At most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1`; defaults to 20.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.maxLimit.description: Largest accepted page size. At most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1`; defaults to 100.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.openAt.description: Open the SQLite module and handle at service activation or the first search, or `never` to disable full-text search: the inherited exact reads, filters, and traces stay available, while `searchSessions` and `searchEvents` fail with `SESSION_QUERY_SEARCH_DISABLED` and SQLite is never imported or opened. Defaults to `startup`.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.path.description: Dedicated derived-index path; `:memory:` is supported for ephemeral indexes. Missing directories and database files are created owner-only on POSIX filesystems; existing modes are preserved.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.persistedReadCo.description: Maximum concurrent persisted-log reads in one inherited batch read. Defaults to 4.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.preparedSession.description: Maximum cold prepared-Session observations the inherited reader retains for reuse. Defaults to 5.

dsh-session-query-sqlite.snippetChars.description: Maximum snippet length in Unicode code points. Defaults to 240.

dsh-session-reference.maxReferenceBytes.description: Explicit maximum rendered UTF-8 bytes per source; absent uses the model-relative budget with a 64 KiB floor.

dsh-session-reference.maxReferences.description: Maximum distinct source sessions referenced by one message, from one to three.

dsh-session-reference.referenceContextFr.description: Fraction of the model context window per source, estimated at four bytes per token; between zero and one.

dsh-session-telemetry-otel.description: Plugin configuration: sharing policy, SDK transport options, byte/count queue settings, and an overall shutdown bound. Uploading modes validate their endpoint and shutdown deadline at plugin load; `DISABLED` reads neither.

dsh-session-telemetry-otel.exporter.description: Explicit SDK HTTP transport settings, including optional routing headers. Ambient credentials are not inherited. URL is required while uploading. Exporter self-observability metering is not supported.

dsh-session-telemetry-otel.maxRequestByt.description: Uncompressed OTLP request byte limit, at most 4,000,000.

dsh-session-telemetry-otel.mode.description: Defaults to `FEEDBACK_ONLY`: capture session history only when feedback is explicitly submitted.

dsh-session-telemetry-otel.processor.description: Count, queue, cadence, and per-request watchdog settings for the byte-bounded processor. A watchdog warning never releases an unsettled transport slot. SDK processor self-observability metering is not supported.

dsh-session-telemetry-otel.shutdownTimeo.description: Maximum time spent awaiting the SDK provider's complete shutdown path.

dsh-session-title.description: Required deterministic fallback and accepted-title limits.

dsh-session-title-all-prompts-llm.description: Required execution controls plus this provider's title-length targets; no defaults.

dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm.description: Required execution controls plus this provider's title-length targets; no defaults.

dsh-shell-env.description: Plugin config (all optional — the built-in facts resolve without defaults).

dsh-shell-env.dshHome.description: DeepSeek Harness home directory exposed as `DSH_HOME`; defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`.

dsh-skill-filesystem.agentsHome.description: Shared agent config root. Defaults to `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME` or `~/.agents`.

dsh-skill-filesystem.bundledSkillDir.description: Bundled skill root; defaults to `$DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR` when default roots are included, otherwise mounts none.

dsh-skill-filesystem.customSkillDirs.description: Additional skill roots scanned after project roots and before user roots.

dsh-skill-filesystem.dshHome.description: DeepSeek Harness config root. Defaults to `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`.

dsh-skill-filesystem.includeDefaultRoots.description: Whether project and user roots are included around custom roots.

dsh-skill-filesystem.watch.description: Whether host-local skill roots are watched for catalog changes.

dsh-skill-filesystem.watchFollowSymlinks.description: Whether watched symbolic links follow their target files.

dsh-skill-filesystem.watchMaxProjects.description: Maximum distinct project roots whose skill directories remain watched.

dsh-skill-filesystem.watchPollIntervalMs.description: Milliseconds between Chokidar stability or polling probes.

dsh-skill-filesystem.watchStabilityThres.description: Milliseconds a changed skill entry must remain stable before it is observed.

dsh-skill-filesystem.watchUsePolling.description: Whether Chokidar uses polling instead of native filesystem events.

dsh-skill-office.assetRoot.description: Absolute assets directory containing skill folders; defaults to packaged assets.

dsh-skill-office.cli.description: Absolute LibreOffice Kit CLI entry; false explicitly disables CLI access.

dsh-skill-office.node.description: Standalone Node executable; defaults to the current executable outside Electron and SEA.

dsh-spill-local.description: Plugin config (all optional — `static Config` supplies the defaults).

dsh-spill-local.cleanupPeriodDays.description: Age in days after which a spill file is eligible for the one-shot startup cleanup sweep. Defaults to `30`; `0` disables cleanup entirely. Files whose `mtime` is strictly older than the cutoff are deleted and emptied directories are pruned; fresh files, symlinks, and unrelated entries are left untouched. On POSIX, cleanup skips roots and session directories that another local user could modify or replace. Retention is deliberate — a resumed or forked session may still reference an older locator until it ages out.

dsh-spill-local.root.description: Root directory for spill files. Omitted uses a lazily-created private (0700) per-process directory under the OS temp dir — the safe default for a local deployment. Set it to keep spill files under a known location.

dsh-spill-policy.maxInlineTokens.description: Maximum estimated tokens in a retained result, including image descriptors and omission notices. Omitted disables retention.

dsh-ssh.description: Deployment-owned SSH identity and installed helper; no model argument selects these values.

dsh-ssh.helper.description: Absolute path to the installed, bundled helper entry.

dsh-ssh.helperHash.description: SHA-256 of that bundled helper; mismatches refuse the connection.

dsh-ssh.host.description: OpenSSH host alias, including its existing user, key and known-host configuration.

dsh-ssh.launch.description: Explicit script or self-contained executable invocation.

dsh-ssh.leaseMs.description: Remote helper lease; loss of heartbeats starts remote managed cleanup.

dsh-ssh.maxFrameBytes.description: Maximum JSON payload bytes per helper request or response.

dsh-ssh.maxPending.description: Maximum ordinary requests; heartbeat and bounded resource cleanup have reserved capacity.

dsh-ssh.requestTimeoutMs.description: Connection and administrative-request deadline, at most 2,147,483,647 milliseconds.

dsh-storage-domain.description: Plugin config. Which backend serves which domain is decided here, not globally on the hub: `backend` is the default route and `routes` overrides it per domain name. A route naming an unregistered backend fails loud at `open` with `backend-not-found`.

dsh-storage-domain.backend.description: Default backend name for every domain without an explicit route. Required: there is no universally correct medium.

dsh-storage-domain.routes.description: Per-domain overrides: domain name → backend name.

dsh-storage-json.description: Plugin configuration. `root` has NO default on purpose: a `process.cwd()` fallback would scatter unit files wherever the process happens to start; assemblies state the location explicitly.

dsh-storage-json.root.description: Directory holding one `<unit>.json` file (or `<unit>/` tree) per unit.

dsh-storage-sqlite.journalMode.description: SQLite `journal_mode` pragma. `wal` (the default) suits local disks; pick a rollback-journal mode (`delete`/`truncate`/`persist`) on filesystems where WAL's shared-memory files do not work (network mounts). See {@link JournalMode}.

dsh-storage-sqlite.path.description: Filesystem path to the SQLite database file. The special value `:memory:` opens an in-process database (tests). On filesystems with POSIX modes, missing directories and databases are created owner-only; existing path modes are preserved. Filesystem setup errors other than an existing database fail the open. The backend does not protect confidentiality or integrity when another principal can replace the database entry in its parent directory.

dsh-subagent.description: Host configuration for continuable subagent capacity.

dsh-subagent-acp.description: Config: how to spawn and drive the child ACP agent process.

dsh-subagent-acp.command.description: The executable to spawn for each run (the child ACP agent).

dsh-subagent-acp.disposeEofGraceMs.description: Grace period (ms) for the child's EOF-driven quiesce on dispose — its window to flush persistence and tear down its own nested subprocesses before the parent escalates to a signal. Must not exceed `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.

dsh-subagent-acp.disposeGraceMs.description: Failure-observation and termination-escalation grace (ms); must not exceed `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.

dsh-subagent-acp.env.description: Extra environment variables for the child process — e.g. the child harness's own `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Forwarded on top of a credential-scrubbed copy of the parent env, so an explicit key here reaches the child while ambient secrets do not leak implicitly.

dsh-subagent-acp.permission.description: How to auto-answer the child's `session/request_permission` prompts: `reject` (default — decline every prompt) or `allow` (approve via the first `allow_once` or `allow_always` option). No prompt is surfaced to a human.

dsh-subagent-claude-code.description: Deployment-owned model, permission, environment, and process-release settings.

dsh-subagent-claude-code.disposeGraceMs.description: Grace in milliseconds between Claude Code managed-range termination tiers.

dsh-subagent-claude-code.env.description: Explicit environment entries layered over the subprocess seam's credential-scrubbed parent environment.

dsh-subagent-claude-code.model.description: Native Claude model fixed for this instance; omitted to inherit Claude settings.

dsh-subagent-claude-code.permissionMode.description: Native non-interactive mode fixed for this Provider instance. Defaults to `dontAsk`; `acceptEdits` accepts edits, `auto` uses the native classifier, `plan` returns a plan without approving execution, and `bypassPermissions` explicitly skips permission checks.

dsh-subagent-codex.description: Deployment-owned model, permission, environment, and process-release settings.

dsh-subagent-codex.disposeGraceMs.description: Grace in milliseconds between app-server managed-range termination tiers.

dsh-subagent-codex.env.description: Explicit environment entries layered over the subprocess seam's credential-scrubbed parent environment.

dsh-subagent-codex.model.description: Native Codex model fixed for this instance; omitted to inherit Codex settings.

dsh-subagent-codex.permissionMode.description: Native non-interactive permission mode fixed for this Provider instance.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.description: Config: how to spawn and drive the child SDK runtime process.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.disposeEofGraceMs.description: Grace period (ms) for the child's EOF-driven quiesce on dispose — its window to flush persistence and tear down its own nested subprocesses before the parent escalates to a signal.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.disposeGraceMs.description: Termination confirmation window (ms), including forced exit on every platform.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.dshBin.description: Explicit dsh CLI module, resolved and checked at plugin load; omission uses the SDK dependency.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.dshHome.description: Absolute isolated Harness home for every nested child process.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.env.description: Extra environment variables for the child process — e.g. the child runtime's own `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Forwarded on top of a credential-scrubbed copy of the parent env, so an explicit key here reaches the child while ambient secrets do not leak implicitly.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.maxTokens.description: Optional per-request output-token cap for the child runtime.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.model.description: Model the child runtime initializes with (default `deepseek-v4-flash`).

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.patches.description: Ordered per-launch profile patch files, resolved and checked at plugin load.

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.provider.description: Provider route the child runtime initializes with (default `deepseek-official`).

dsh-subagent-dsh-sdk.shutdownTimeoutMs.description: Bound (ms) on the protocol `shutdown` exchange during dispose.

dsh-subagent-fork-in-process.description: Config: the registry name to register the provider under.

dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process.description: Config: the registry name to register the provider under.

dsh-subagent.maxActiveSubagents.description: Maximum live children sharing uninterrupted continuable parent links; defaults to 8.

dsh-subagent.maxDepth.description: Default delegation depth for tools without an explicit limit; defaults to 1.

dsh-system-prompt.description: Plugin config: the deployment-authored fragment of the system prompt (see {@link Config.personaPrefix} for its contract).

dsh-system-prompt.includeHarnessIdentity.description: Include the fixed DeepSeek Harness identity before the deployment persona (default true).

dsh-system-prompt.includeRuntimeContext.description: Include optional runtime-context snapshots in model history (default true); required context remains.

dsh-system-prompt.personaPrefix.description: Deployment-wide persona prefix template before first-party guidance. A scoped section named `deployment:persona-prefix` shadows it; `{{variable}}` references are strict.

dsh-system-prompt.personaSuffix.description: Persona suffix template after first-party guidance. A scoped `deployment:persona-suffix` section shadows it; `{{variable}}` references are strict. Defaults to empty.

dsh-system-prompt.toolOrder.description: Model-facing tool names in order, with {@link TOOL_ORDER_REST} exactly once. Invalid fields fail at load and unknown names fail at assembly; known names hidden in one scope may be absent there. Omitted means lexicographic order.

dsh-terminal-bash.exactProbeAfterMs.description: Delay before Linux exact syscall probes.

dsh-terminal-bash.handoffGraceMs.description: Extra wait beyond `idleSilenceMs`, once a prompt marker was seen, for the shell to regain the foreground before `inferred_idle` settles; at least one `pollIntervalMs`.

dsh-terminal-bash.maxReadBytes.description: Maximum bytes returned by one read or settled viewport.

dsh-terminal-bash.promptTailGraceMs.description: Extra wait beyond `idleSilenceMs` and `handoffGraceMs`, once a prompt marker was seen but its printable tail has not arrived, before `inferred_idle` settles. The marker is written by the shell's own prompt function and the tail by the same render, so a missing tail is a delivery delay on a contended host rather than an absent prompt. Zero keeps the bound at `idleSilenceMs + handoffGraceMs`; any other value covers at least one `pollIntervalMs`, so a nonzero tolerance always contains a readiness poll.

dsh-terminal-bash.shellArgs.description: Shell arguments (default per dialect: bash `--noprofile --norc -i`, pwsh `-NoLogo -NoProfile`).

dsh-terminal-bash.shellDialect.description: Interactive shell dialect (default: `bash`); selects the argv/env/startup defaults.

dsh-terminal-bash.shellPath.description: Interactive shell executable (default per dialect: `/bin/bash`, or the resolved pwsh).

dsh-terminal-bash.timeoutMs.description: Absolute bound for one send and the complete pwsh startup sequence.

dsh-time-context.description: Request-preparation clock formatting and append scheduling. Invalid values fail plugin load.

dsh-time-context.refreshIntervalMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between durable injections in one session. Defaults to 600000 (10 minutes); 0 injects at every eligible step.

dsh-time-context.timeZone.description: Fallback display zone when the open turn has no unique browser zone. Omit to use the process zone.

dsh-tmux-context.description: Per-turn tmux-location scheduling. Invalid values fail plugin load.

dsh-tmux-context.refreshIntervalMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between durable injections in one session. Omit or set to 0 to inject on every eligible change.

dsh-tool-ask-user.description: Cordis row selecting the tool schema and its default foreground wait.

dsh-tool-ask-user.mode.description: Tool definition selected by this Cordis row. Defaults to the blocking legacy tool.

dsh-tool-ask-user.timeout.description: Foreground wait before automatic continuation. Defaults to 120 seconds.

dsh-tool-bash-persistent.description: Configuration for the persistent Bash tool.

dsh-tool-bash-persistent.backendType.description: PTY backend used for each owner-isolated persistent shell (default `shell`).

dsh-tool-bash-persistent.description.description: Model-facing tool description; deployments may describe their environment.

dsh-tool-bash-persistent.maxOutputChars.description: Maximum returned command-output characters before clipping (default 16000).

dsh-tool-bash.enableRunInBackground.description: Expose `run_in_background` while a job registry is composed (default true); disabled calls are also rejected. Without a registry the tool is foreground-only regardless.

dsh-tool-bash.promoteOnTimeout.description: Keep a foreground command that reaches its timeout running as a background job instead of killing it (default true). Applies only while background execution is available: with `enableRunInBackground` false or no job registry, the executor's deadline kills the command. A foreground command the registry refuses at its start (admission or a missing controller) also runs under the deadline kill.

dsh-tool-fs.description: Plugin config (all optional — `Config` supplies the defaults).

dsh-tool-fs-search.description: Plugin config; over-cap glob sampling is an explicit deployment choice and the remaining fields have defaults.

dsh-tool-fs-search.globMaxResults.description: Max paths one `glob` call retains inline; later paths go to the formatted spill file.

dsh-tool-fs-search.graceMs.description: Terminate-escalation grace (ms), handed to the subprocess seam and bounded by `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`.

dsh-tool-fs-search.grepMaxLineBytes.description: Max bytes retained for one matched-line preview (the cut preserves UTF-8 boundaries).

dsh-tool-fs-search.grepMaxMatches.description: Max flat matches one `grep` call retains inline; later matches go to the formatted spill file.

dsh-tool-fs-search.rawOutputMaxBytes.description: Max complete raw `rg` stdout bytes a search will parse; larger raw output fails with `SEARCH_RAW_OUTPUT_OVERFLOW`.

dsh-tool-fs-search.sampleOverCapGlobResu.description: Whether an over-cap `glob` page is sampled across top-level entries instead of taking the modification-time head.

dsh-tool-fs-search.searchMetaMaxBytes.description: Max bytes of one search's serialized `presentationMeta`; trailing groups/paths drop past it so the persisted card stays bounded.

dsh-tool-fs-search.stderrMaxBytes.description: Max bytes retained for one search's stderr tail; the excerpt is embedded in `SEARCH_*` error messages, never shown on success.

dsh-tool-fs-search.timeoutMs.description: Cooperative tool-call timeout budget (ms) on both tools, enforced by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy` through `exec.signal`.

dsh-tool-fs.applyPatch.description: Register `apply_patch` and its guidance beside `edit`. Defaults to false; shipped compositions set it on their `tool-fs` rows.

dsh-tool-fs.edit.description: Register `edit` and its guidance. Defaults to true.

dsh-tool-fs.read.description: Register `read` and its guidance. Defaults to true.

dsh-tool-fs.readImage.description: Register `read_image` while an attachment store is mounted. Defaults to true.

dsh-tool-fs.readLimit.description: Default and maximum number of lines returned by one `read` call.

dsh-tool-fs.readMaxBytes.description: Maximum bytes returned for the selected lines of one `read` call.

dsh-tool-fs.readMaxLineLength.description: Maximum characters returned for a single line before truncation.

dsh-tool-fs.readStreamMinSize.description: Files at or above this size stream instead of loading whole into memory.

dsh-tool-fs.write.description: Register `write` and its guidance. Defaults to true.

dsh-tool-goal.description: Model policy and hard lower bounds for goal-state updates.

dsh-tool-goal.blockedAfterConsecutiveRou.description: Minimum admitted goal rounds before the model may self-report `blocked`.

dsh-tool-jobs.description: Configures bounded `job_output` waits and completion-notice delivery.

dsh-tool-jobs.completionDelivery.description: Whether a completion opens a turn on an idle owner (default `wakeup`).

dsh-tool-jobs.inlineOutputBytes.description: Largest complete completion notice, in UTF-8 bytes, that carries the job's output and final result inline (default 2048); a larger one, or one over the producer's `outputLimitBytes`, leaves them for `job_output`. 0 never inlines.

dsh-tool-jobs.maxConsecutiveWakes.description: Turns one owner may have opened by completion wakes before the next notice degrades to injection, reset by any user-authored input. Absent by default: every idle completion wakes its owner. Set it to bound the self-exciting chain where a woken turn starts the job whose completion wakes it again, at the cost of notices past the cap waiting silently for the next user input.

dsh-tool-jobs.maxWaitTimeoutMs.description: Hard cap on any single wait; a larger model-supplied `timeout_ms` is clamped down to it (default 10min).

dsh-tool-jobs.waitTimeoutMs.description: Wait duration applied when `job_output` sets `wait` without `timeout_ms` (default 30s).

dsh-tool-lsp.description: Plugin configuration: result caps and the timeout budget.

dsh-tool-lsp.maxLocations.description: Largest number of rendered locations before an omission marker (default 100).

dsh-tool-lsp.maxResultChars.description: Largest complete rendered result in characters, including truncation metadata (default 16000).

dsh-tool-present.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files in one call.

dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent.description: Configuration for the persistent pwsh tool.

dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent.backendType.description: PTY backend used for each owner-isolated persistent shell (default `shell`).

dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent.description.description: Model-facing tool description; deployments may describe their environment.

dsh-tool-pwsh-persistent.maxOutputChars.description: Maximum returned command-output characters before clipping (default 16000).

dsh-tool-pwsh.enableRunInBackground.description: Expose `run_in_background` while a job registry is composed (default true); disabled calls are also rejected. Without a registry the tool is foreground-only regardless.

dsh-tool-pwsh.promoteOnTimeout.description: Keep a foreground command that reaches its timeout running as a background job instead of killing it (default true). Applies only while background execution is available: with `enableRunInBackground` false or no job registry, the executor's deadline kills the command. A foreground command the registry refuses at its start (admission or a missing controller) also runs under the deadline kill.

dsh-tool-ralph.description: Deployment policy for the fixed Ralph workflow.

dsh-tool-ralph.maxHandoffChars.description: Maximum serialized characters in one structured handoff (default 16384).

dsh-tool-ralph.maxResultChars.description: Maximum characters in a successful parent-facing terminal text (default 16384).

dsh-tool-ralph.maxRounds.description: Default and deployment ceiling for one call's round count (default 256).

dsh-tool-ralph.subagentProvider.description: Fresh structured-output provider used for every round (default `spawn`).

dsh-tool-session-query.description: Deployment-owned search count and timeout bounds.

dsh-tool-session-query.maxSearchResults.description: Maximum authorized hits returned by one search call. Defaults to 100.

dsh-tool-session-query.searchTimeoutMs.description: Cooperative full-text search deadline in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

dsh-tool-skill.catalogDescriptionMaxLeng.description: Maximum normalized description length rendered in the session catalog; minimum 3.

dsh-tool-str-replace-editor.description: Configuration for the string-replacement editor tool.

dsh-tool-str-replace-editor.maxOutputCha.description: Maximum returned view characters before clipping (default 16000).

dsh-tool-subagent.description: Config: which registered provider this tool delegates to, plus child defaults.

dsh-tool-subagent.agentOptions.description: Agent options applied to every child; omitted fields use child-loop defaults.

dsh-tool-subagent.maxDepth.description: Maximum child depth: a non-negative safe integer (`0` forbids delegation), or `'provider-managed'` to send no cap. A numeric cap requires the provider's `depthLimit` capability (mount fails loud otherwise). The provider checks the calling agent's current depth at every start; the tool remains model-visible so runtime policy owns rejection. `'provider-managed'` is for an out-of-process provider whose recursion budget belongs to the child runtime or its own deployment. Omission reads the current Host subagent depth setting (default `1`) at each delegation.

dsh-tool-subagent.modelDiscovery.description: Register the shared `list_subagent_models` tool for this scope. Enable on only one instance per scope; defaults to false and does not enable model selection. Discovery is removed when this instance unloads.

dsh-tool-subagent.modelSelection.description: Expose optional child `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` fields. Requires provider `agentOptions` support. Execution enforces the Session policy, or restricts explicit selection to the current parent route.

dsh-tool-subagent.provider.description: The `ctx.subagents` provider name to start runs on (e.g. `spawn`, `acp`).

dsh-tool-subagent.toolName.description: Model-facing tool name (default `subagent`). Each loaded instance must use a distinct name.

dsh-tool-terminal.enableRunInBackground.description: Expose `run_in_background` and accept background sends (default true).

dsh-tool-terminal.maxResultBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in one complete terminal or task-output result.

dsh-tool-todo.allowParallelInProgress.description: Required deployment choice for whether several todos may be `in_progress` at once. True suits agents that run work concurrently — subagents, background commands, workflow fan-out — and the description then instructs the model to mark every actively worked task. False restores the single-active discipline: the description asks for exactly one, and a call marking more is rejected.

dsh-tool-web.description: Plugin config: which web tools to register, search bounds, per-tool budgets, and the fetch output cap.

dsh-tool-web.fetchMaxOutputChars.description: Cap on source characters converted and complete `web_fetch` output characters. Defaults to 200000.

dsh-tool-web.fetchTimeoutMs.description: Cooperative timeout budget (ms) for `web_fetch`. Defaults to 30000.

dsh-tool-web.searchMaxQueries.description: Upper bound on queries accepted by one `web_search` call.

dsh-tool-web.searchMaxResults.description: Upper bound on sources returned by one `web_search` call.

dsh-tool-web.searchSummaryMaxChars.description: Cap on each source summary in `web_search` output, in characters. Defaults to 800.

dsh-tool-web.searchTimeoutMs.description: Cooperative timeout budget (ms) for `web_search`. Defaults to 30000.

dsh-tool-workflow.description: Config: the model-facing tool name plus result rendering caps.

dsh-tool-workflow.enableRunInBackground.description: Expose `run_in_background` (default true); disabled calls are also rejected. A background run needs a live `ctx.jobs` registry with a controller serving the caller (`dsh-jobs-local` plus `dsh-tool-jobs` in the shipped composition); without one the call fails with the missing piece named.

dsh-tool-workflow.maxResultChars.description: Rendered-result ceiling, in characters: a longer JSON value is truncated with a notice (default 50000).

dsh-tool-workflow.toolName.description: The model-facing tool name to register (default `workflow`).

dsh-tool-workspace-dependencies.description: Payload location and optional installation directory.

dsh-typert-loader.description: Additional package artifacts whose owning plugins are nested behind another Loader entry.

dsh-typert-loader.packages.description: Exact npm package names that must resolve and export `./typert`.

dsh-user-approval.description: Plugin config. All optional — `static Config` supplies the defaults.

dsh-web.description: Config for the web seam. `searchProvider` / `fetchProvider` pin which provider wins for each capability; both are optional (a single registered usable provider auto-selects). Each operation reads the current value, so a settings change applies to the next search or fetch without remounting the service. Operational overrides such as environment variables must feed these same fields rather than introduce a hidden priority chain.

dsh-web-app.description: Plugin config: composed deployment settings plus per-invocation command-line values.

dsh-web-app.openBrowser.description: Permit default-browser handoff after the Loader tree settles; an SSH launch suppresses it.

dsh-web-app.printUrl.description: Print the URL line on activation; a non-interactive layer can turn it off.

dsh-web-app.publicUrl.description: Canonical HTTP(S) root to advertise in the printed and opened URL, `DSH_WEB_URL`, and `webApp.getAdvertisedUrl()`, which supplies the Web GUI URL in agent runtime context, e.g. `https://app.example/ui/`, normalized to end in `/`. Configures no routing or authentication; see [public deployments](../README.md#public-deployments). Absent or YAML `null` advertises the bind-address URL.

dsh-web-app.surfaceContext.description: Register the `DSH_WEB_URL` bash variable naming this GUI. A one-shot non-interactive layer can turn it off when its user is not in the GUI.

dsh-web-deepseek-api.description: Settings read by the next search or fetch without re-registering either provider.

dsh-web-deepseek-api.apiKey.description: Literal DeepSeek API key; prefer {@link apiKeyEnv} so no secret enters configuration files.

dsh-web-deepseek-api.apiKeyEnv.description: Credential reference resolved for each operation; defaults to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.

dsh-web-deepseek-api.baseURL.description: API base including its path prefix; `/search` and `/fetch` are appended.

dsh-web-deepseek-api.count.description: Search API results per search, from 1 through 50; a smaller request bound wins. Defaults to 10.

dsh-web-deepseek-api.sendOriginalQuestio.description: Send the triggering user question, bounded to 128 characters, as `ori_question`. Defaults to true.

dsh-web-fetch-http.description: Plugin config: the provider's transport and size limits plus its `User-Agent` (all defaulted).

dsh-web-fetch-http.maxBodyChars.description: Maximum decoded body length in characters.

dsh-web-fetch-http.maxRedirects.description: Maximum number of same-origin redirect hops to follow.

dsh-web-fetch-http.maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum response body size in bytes.

dsh-web-fetch-http.timeoutMs.description: Default fetch timeout in milliseconds, within Node's timer range.

dsh-web-search-deepseek.description: Plugin config (all optional — `apply` fills env-var and constant defaults).

dsh-web-search-deepseek.apiKey.description: Literal DeepSeek API key; prefer {@link apiKeyEnv} so no secret enters configuration files.

dsh-web-search-deepseek.apiKeyEnv.description: Credential reference resolved for each search; defaults to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.

dsh-web-search-deepseek.maxTokens.description: Upper bound on generated tokens for the Messages request. Defaults to 4096.

dsh-web-search-deepseek.maxUses.description: Maximum `web_search` server-tool uses per request. Defaults to 5.

dsh-web-search-exa.description: Plugin config (all optional — `apply` fills env-var and constant defaults).

dsh-web-search-exa.apiKey.description: Exa API key. Falls back to `$EXA_API_KEY`. Empty → provider unavailable.

dsh-web-search-exa.baseURL.description: Endpoint base; `/search` is appended. Defaults to the public API.

dsh-web-search-exa.highlightsPerResult.description: Highlight sentences requested per result. Defaults to 1.

dsh-web-search-exa.numResults.description: Default result count when a request carries no `maxResults`. Omitted = none.

dsh-web-search-exa.searchType.description: Retrieval mode sent as Exa's `type`. Defaults to `auto`.

dsh-web-search-perplexity.description: Plugin config (all optional — `apply` fills env-var and constant defaults).

dsh-web-search-perplexity.apiKey.description: Perplexity API key. Falls back to `$PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`. Empty → unavailable.

dsh-web-search-perplexity.baseURL.description: Endpoint base; `/chat/completions` is appended. Defaults to the public API.

dsh-web-search-perplexity.maxTokens.description: Upper bound on generated answer tokens. Defaults to 1024.

dsh-web-search-perplexity.searchRecency.description: Recency window sent as `search_recency_filter`. Omitted = no filter.

dsh-workflow-ptc.description: Plugin config (all optional — `static Config` supplies the defaults).

dsh-workflow-ptc.maxConcurrentAgents.description: Concurrent `agent()` ceiling; `0` (the default) auto-resolves to `min(16, max(1, cores - 2))`.

dsh-workflow-ptc.maxItemsPerCall.description: Items accepted by a single `parallel()`/`pipeline()` call (default 4096).

dsh-workflow-ptc.maxTotalAgents.description: Total `agent()` calls one run may start — the runaway-loop backstop (default 1000).

dsh-workflow-ptc.syncTimeoutMs.description: VM timeout for the script's initial synchronous slice (default 5000 ms).

dsh-working-directory.description: Deployment default for Sessions without an original project directory.

dsh-working-directory.defaultDirectory.description: Absolute execution-world fallback directory; omitted values use the launch directory.

dsh-workspace-changes.description: Snapshot, capture, and comparison bounds. Invalid values fail plugin load.

dsh-workspace-changes.diffTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a line comparison may run before it degrades to whole-file replacement.

dsh-workspace-changes.maxFileBytes.description: Bytes a file may hold to be captured around a file-tool edit or read from a snapshot for its comparison. A larger file gets no comparison; one captured around a file-tool edit is also listed without counts.

dsh-workspace-changes.maxFiles.description: Maximum files carried by one summary; `total` still reports the complete count.

dsh-workspace-changes.outputMaxBytes.description: Bytes of git output retained per command; a larger diff listing abandons the record.

dsh-workspace-changes.timeoutMs.description: Milliseconds one git command may run before the turn's record is abandoned.
